english:
Reaching Critical Health from Combatant damage fires 2 seeking micro-missiles, and casting your Super fires 4.

Each missile deals Kinetic damage based on your class: Hunters and Warlocks deal <pve 217 /> <pvp [31] />, and Titans deal <pve 680 /> <pvp [31] />.

source.text:
4 Piece | God-Like Judgment

Upon reaching Critical Health through Combatant Damage, or on Super Cast:
Fires multiple Seeking Micro-Missiles, each dealing Class-based [31] Kinetic Damage.
Critical Health = 2 Missiles | Super Cast = 4 Missiles

Hunters = 217 Damage | Titan = 680 Damage | Warlocks = 217 Damage
